name: DNA ligase 4

function.text: LIG4 encodes DNA ligase 4. Annotated molecular activities include ligase activity and DNA ligase activity. It participates in V(D)J recombination and base-excision repair.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to DNA ligase IV deficiency (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
